contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions Received this Period' = $1,012.30 on the p4 Summary Page — the PROMOTED per-period cell — which is also Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' $1,012.30 AND its printed 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of all Schedule A pages in this report)' $1,012.30. Three printed statements of the same period-scoped figure agree.
contributions.detail: The 9 Schedule A rows on p2 sum to 50.00 + 100.00 + 26.00 + 10.00 + 25.00 + 50.00 + 50.00 + 50.00 + 651.30 = 1,012.30 exactly = the printed page subtotal = the printed Total Contributions Received = Box B. Single schedule sheet, so the page subtotal and the sum-of-all-pages footer are the same scope and both were checked (per ADDENDUM N3 the footer's caption was not trusted on its face — it prints the same figure as the page subtotal, i.e. it is genuinely this report's total, not a cycle figure). Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' is CUMULATIVE and is never summed as an increment; it is also struck through and rewritten on this filing (see notes) and was not used. THE LOAN ROW IS A CONTRIBUTION ROW BY THE LADDER, NOT BY ITS WORDING (ADDENDUM B3): Box A 'Balance at Beginning' prints 0, so there is no beginning-balance slot for the filer's own $651.30 loan; without it the rows total 361.00 against a stated 1,012.30, and with it they close to the cent. Row 3 is 26.00 and not 25.00 for the same reason — 25.00 would leave the page 1.00 short of its own printed subtotal (arithmetic closure over glyph reading, GOTCHAS).
contributions.cross_checks: Box F 'Subtotal before Expenditures (Box A + Box B)' prints $1,012.30 = 0 + 1,012.30, and the unlettered 'Balance at Close (Box F - Box D)' prints $0 = 1,012.30 - 1,012.30. The filer's own ladder is internally consistent and independently corroborates both promoted anchors.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' = $1,012.30 on the p4 Summary Page — the PROMOTED per-period cell — which is also Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' $1,012.30 AND its printed 'Total Expenditures Made (Sum of all Schedule B pages in this report)' $1,012.30.
expenditures.detail: The 8 Schedule B rows on p3 sum to 25.00 + 25.00 + 48.19 + 23.27 + 5.06 + 848.28 + 22.48 + 15.02 = 1,012.30 exactly = the printed page subtotal = the printed Total Expenditures Made = Box D. Box E 'Expenditures Made Year to Date' prints $947.28 and is CUMULATIVE — never summed as an increment, and NOT used as a gate (note it is SMALLER than the period figure, one of two internal inconsistencies in the filer's cumulative column; see notes). Single schedule sheet, so page subtotal and sum-of-all-pages footer share a scope; both were read and agree (ADDENDUM N3 screen).
expenditures.cross_checks: The filer's own $848.28 to 'Utah County / filing fee' independently equals the 2026 County Clerk fee data point recorded in ADDENDUM O4. Recorded as an observation ONLY — per ADDENDUM E1/L3 the filing fee is never used to corroborate or settle a figure, and this page closes on its own arithmetic without it.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only closes both sides exactly. BOTH conventions were tested per ADDENDUM G1/O4 (per REPORT, never inherited): neither schedule on this 2026 printing carries an in-kind column or checkbox (Schedule A is Date / Name of Contributor / City and Zip Code / Amount; Schedule B is Date / Provider/Vendor / Purpose / Amount), no row is annotated in-kind or as a gift, and no row is entered twice across the two schedules — so monetary-only and monetary-plus-in-kind give the identical sum 1,012.30 and both close. in_kind=false on every row is a reading of the page, not a default.
itemized.escalation_note: Six tight-crop escalations, all at 500-900 dpi, none of which changed a figure: (1) p2 row 1 amount at 900 dpi rendered '$50.' — a trailing decimal point with NO cents digits, recorded 50.00; (2) p2 row 9 amount at 900 dpi, deliberately WIDENED to x=79.5 w=15.5 per ADDENDUM G2 because the figure runs to the printed right-hand rule, rendered '$651.30' complete; (3) p2 row 10 control at 900 dpi rendered an EMPTY cell; (4) p3 row 1 rendered '$25', row 8 rendered '$15.02', row 9 control rendered EMPTY; (5) the p2 date column at 600 dpi and the p3 date column at 600 dpi, to settle the DOWNWARD-ARROW carry-down (see notes); (6) the p2 Name column at 500 dpi and the p3 Provider/Purpose columns at 400 dpi, to settle donor and vendor spellings and to confirm the ditto marks. No cell was doubtful enough after escalation to leave blank.

itemized.notes: TERI McCABE, 2026, Utah County Clerk — '30 Days after withdrawal or elimination', Date of Report 4 May 2026, clerk stamp 'Received MAY 05 2026 In Person'. Amendment question answered No. Page face agrees with index.csv on candidate ('Teri McCabe') and office (the Office box prints 'Utah County Clerk' in the filer's hand). 4 pages, foliated by the filer 1/2/3/4 counting the cover, and every page classified from its own printed header: p1 cover, p2 'Schedule A - Itemized Contributions Received', p3 'Schedule B - Itemized Expenditures Made', p4 'Summary Page'. NO checklist decoy is bound into this filing. || 2026 FORM PROPERTIES beyond ADDENDUM O1, all confirmed on the page: the footer prints 'v. 12.23' (so the revision string is again not a cycle signal), the 'Where to File' block gives disclosures@utahcounty.gov while the footer prints elections@utahcounty.gov, report-type and amendment controls are SQUARE CHECKBOXES, and the close box is UNLETTERED. **NEW: this 2026 Schedule A prints its third column as 'City and Zip Code' — NOT the 'Address and Zip Code' that ADDENDUM M2 records for the v. 12.23 sheets, and not the 2022 blank's 'City and State'.** There is no in-kind checkbox. That makes the privacy reduction a near no-op here: no street address is printed anywhere on either schedule, so nothing had to be dropped at read time, and a blank donor_state is the filer's own omission (city+ZIP, no state), never a redaction. Schedule B keeps a real Purpose column (Date / Provider/Vendor / Purpose / Amount). || REDACTION: two black bars on the cover only — over the candidate's address block and over the signature line. Neither schedule is redacted; every donor cell on p2 is the filer's own writing, published in the clear by the county. || THE FILER'S CUMULATIVE COLUMN IS INTERNALLY INCONSISTENT AND WAS NOT USED FOR ANYTHING. Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' has an initial figure scribbled out so heavily it is illegible (NOT transcribed, NOT guessed) followed by a surviving unstruck '$211'; Box E 'Expenditures Made Year to Date' prints $947.28, which is LESS than the same report's period figure of $1,012.30. Both are transcribed as facts about the document and adjudicated in no direction — utah is a per-period regime and the promoted anchors are Box B and Box D, both of which close exactly. || The row-index screens were all run and all came back negative: the first written entry is band 1 on both schedules (no skipped line, ADDENDUM A1), no banner line, no voided row, no doubled band, and the one-band-past control rendered EMPTY on both pages, so no ledger continues below the last printed rule. The FIELD-SHIFT screen passes by content on both sides: p2's third column holds place names and p3's third column holds purposes ('Campaign software', 'Clipboards', 'Copies', 'Pens', 'filing fee'), each matching its printed heading.
